card.name: First digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: A single digit token that begins a longer number, such as the 2 in 2,000 or the 4 in 48 or 400. It is common right before a unit like Kelvin, mg, hours or kilograms.

modes.label: Leading digit of thousands
modes.description: First digit of a number written with a comma or zeros, followed by a unit.

modes.label: Leading digit in doses and times
modes.description: First digit of a dose, activity or time value in a drug-label passage.
modes.example: ELIQUIS should be discontinued at least <<4>>8 hours prior to elective surgery

modes.label: Digit before a unit
modes.description: A single digit that is a whole value in a spec, directly before a unit such as GB.

card.plain: It marks the first digit of a number that is still being written out, before the rest of the number and its unit.
